title: auth.user.lifecycle (schema_version 1)
description: Published by the auth service's account module via the outbox (D-009) whenever an account's lifecycle state changes. Partition key = accountUuid. See the eventType property for the specific transition - status alone is ambiguous (e.g. ACTIVE results from user.registered, user.reinstated, or user.unlocked alike).

accountUuid.description: External account identifier — the same value used as the JWT 'sub' claim.

email.description: The account's own email address at the time the event was published — added to unblock notification-service's own contact projection (T05), which otherwise has no channel to obtain a recipient address without a synchronous Auth call (forbidden by L2).

eventType.description: The specific lifecycle transition. Known values today: user.registered, user.suspended, user.reinstated, user.deleted, user.locked, user.unlocked. Deliberately not a closed enum (mirrors the purpose field on auth.email.requested) - added to unblock notification-service's own T06, which otherwise cannot distinguish e.g. user.registered from user.reinstated/user.unlocked, all of which produce status=ACTIVE alike.
